scenes.title: Teaching, thanksgiving, and the common fruit
A maker who does not know his mother
Bridal return and what remains outside

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-va.title: the Ogdoad — the four primary conjunctions
the Decad and Duodecad — two branches of further generation
Sophia — youngest of the Duodecad, joined to Theletos
Nous alone comprehends the Father; the rest long and are restrained
Sophia's solitary reach — apart from Theletos, nearing dissolution in the Father's sweetness
Horos / Stauros — the same power establishing and dividing
the enthymesis — the intention excluded with its passion; later called Achamoth
the amorphous-birth variant — a second articulation, not silently merged
the earlier Christ — produced by Monogenes and Aletheia; teacher of the Aeons
the Holy Spirit — bringing thanksgiving and rest
the contributions — each Aeon's most beautiful, composing one common fruit
the Soter — Jesus, Saviour, called also Christ, Logos and Everything because he comes from all
Achamoth in darkness and vacuity — formless, like an untimely birth
the first formation — according to substance; the odour of immortality left behind
the affects becoming cosmos — tears→liquid, smile→lucid, grief/perplexity→corporeal; the second account: fear→psychic, grief→wicked spirits
the second formation — the Soter strengthening her; passions separated into substrates; spiritual seed conceived in the angels' likeness
Horos stops her crossing back — her cry of Iao
Achamoth — moving him without making herself known
the Demiurge — ordering the substances, ruling the Hebdomas
the seven heavens; Achamoth's Ogdoad dwelling above him, below the Pleroma
the second affect table — earth: stupor, water: fear, air: grief, fire inherent in the three
the human — earth, psychic breath, skins; the spiritual seed placed within the Demiurge unknowingly
the bridal chamber — Achamoth joined to the Soter; the spiritual to the angels
the Demiurge's reward — the intermediate dwelling; righteous psychic souls resting, not entering
fire consuming matter and finally itself
the founding comparison — Offered; human-amplified: no: Sophia's reach, Horos's limit, the common fruit beside 0/1→4+2
